$comment: cache-aware-routing control plane. Frontier-only-safe: no frontier_cadence and no
degrade_to_local budget, because both need a local fleet to fall back to and this
deployment has none (it would refuse to start otherwise). See PLAN.md Phase 2 for
when to add these. The turn key's SECRET is never in this file -- only sha256(secret).
Run mint_keys.py to fill in the key_sha256 fields. Set the plain secret as
ROUNDHOUSE_API_KEY in the agent environment so it sends it on x-roundhouse-key.
credentials.providers.nvidia.env_var names the variable the server reads at startup;
it must be exported (INFERENCE_API_KEY) or the server refuses to load.
To enable Tax B (cross-session cache hit), add a second user and key entry here.
See PLAN.md Phase 1 for the exact diff.
